# Barttery 1.2.2
- Fixes a packaging error that prevented device helpers from starting in signed releases, affecting iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch readings. - Bundled libraries now resolve relative to each helper, including transitive dependencies, without relying on `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH`. - Keeps Hardened Runtime and library validation enabled. - Adds build-time dependency checks and sets helper executable permissions before signing, instead of modifying installed application resources at launch. - Fixes last-update timestamps for Logitech and other accessories, preserving each device's own measurement time when it is renamed or cached. - Replaces excessive elapsed-time counters with readable units and explicit unknown-date states; widgets use the same per-device timestamps.
Version 1.2.1 users can use Sparkle once this release is published. Users of 1.2.0 and earlier must update manually or through Homebrew.

# Barttery 1.2.1
- Adds Sparkle in-app updates. When an update is found, **Update Available…** appears below **Launch at Login**. Click it to review and install the update. - Adds a Liquid Glass application icon for macOS 26 and later, with a static fallback for older macOS versions. - Includes the desktop battery widget and existing Logitech battery monitoring improvements.
Version 1.2.0 users must install this release manually or through Homebrew to enable future in-app updates.
